title: Re-created one of my game's trailer with Astra
author: PartTimeMonkey
selftext:
I had Astra re-do my trailer with a one-shot. 

For anyone who's fiddled with AI, I think this trailer looks slightly "too AI", but that would likely easily be taken care of by just showing some desired reference pics and better "direction."

Could be a lot better with a bit more time put into it (and selecting a better background song), but it's super impressive what it can do by just letting it do whatever it wants, more or less.

In comparison the previous trailer, which I made by hand and took me probably a day or two, can be seen here:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5011870/Ballad](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5011870/Ballad)
